correctness.rationale: For q>=3 distinct letter-runs per period and all positive run lengths and k>=1, adjacent half-windows with equal Parikh vectors reduce after deleting full periods to two disjoint circular arcs. The q>=3 unique-run circular-support lemma makes such adjacent arcs monochromatic; for length residue above p/2 the same follows from complement arcs. Long factors encode their starting phase uniquely since the cyclic period is primitive. Counting run placements gives F_h=sum_i max(0,r_i-2h+1), initial T(1)=d and T(2)=d+e, and T(k+2)-T(k)=B=p+2 sum_i floor(r_i^2/4). Thus T(k)=d+(k-1)B/2 for odd k, d+(k/2-1)B+e for even k. Independently enumerated literal distinct contiguous factors for 215 selected run-vector/power cases (1902 half-length profiles), all agreeing with the symbolic total/spectrum. The finite checks corroborate, not prove, the arbitrary-parameter theorem.
